subject: Budget Needs Assessment Ordinance
overview: The subcommittee met to discuss paper 22-494 regarding a proposed budget needs assessment ordinance and broader improvements to Medford's annual budget process. Members kept the paper in committee and instructed the subcommittee chair to prepare two framework memoranda for future review with legal counsel and finance staff.

items.title: Budget Needs Assessment Ordinance
items.summary: Subcommittee members brainstormed ideas for establishing a formal budget needs assessment process, expanding public participation, improving finance department reporting, and seeking broader council authority over budget line items through potential home rule legislation. The paper was kept in committee, and the chair was tasked with drafting framework memoranda for future review with city finance and legal staff.
